## 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex: I'm always frustrated when [...]

## ✨ Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. If this is a new template proposal, describe the aesthetic style, target industry (e.g. AI, SaaS, Web3), and key sections.

## 🎨 Mockups or Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions, designs, or features you've considered.

## 🚀 Additional context
Add any other context, screenshots, or inspiration links about the feature request here.
